opportunities.name: JetBlue flight search with sort/filter
opportunities.description: On jetblue.com, search flights from {origin} to {destination} for {trip_type} on {depart_date}/{return_date}, optionally paying with TrueBlue points, then open Sort & Filter, pick a sort order and apply it.
steps: Open the jetblue.com home page, Flights tab
Set the trip type (Roundtrip/One-way)
Type the origin in From and pick the airport or city area from the dropdown
Type the destination in To and pick it from the dropdown
Open the Depart calendar and pick the departure date
Pick the return date if it is a roundtrip
Optionally tick 'Use TrueBlue points'
Click Search flights and, if a warning modal appears, click 'Continue to flight results'
Optionally switch the results to Points
Open Sort & Filter, pick a sort order (e.g. price low to high), and click Apply

instances.values: JFK→MIA, roundtrip, Mar 27–Mar 31, switched to points, sort Price by Core
NYC area→Toronto YYZ, one-way, Apr 29, sort price low to high
NYC area→Aruba AUA, roundtrip, May 1–May 5, TrueBlue points, sort price low to high

opportunities.name: Avis Budget Group careers job search with filters
opportunities.description: From the Budget site footer, go to Careers > Openings and filter jobs by {country}, {team} and {time_type}, then run the search.
steps: On budget.com, scroll to the footer and click Careers
On the Avis Budget Group careers page, click Openings
Open the Country filter and select the country
Open the Team filter and select the team
Open the Time Type filter and select the time type
Click 'Search by job title or keyword'
Optionally open a job posting and click Apply Now

instances.values: United States, Finance, Full time; opened Accounts Payable Associate and clicked Apply Now

opportunities.name: United car rental search
opportunities.description: On united.com, open Book > Car, enter {pickup_location}, pick {pickup_date}–{dropoff_date} and the pickup/drop-off times, then click Find cars.
steps: On the united.com home page, open the Car tab of the Book widget
Optionally toggle 'Book with miles'
Type the pickup location and pick a suggestion
Open the Pickup date calendar and pick the pickup date, then the drop-off date
Optionally set the pickup time and drop-off time
Click Find cars

instances.values: Caldwell (Ohio), Apr 8–Apr 13, 8:00 a.m.–12:00 p.m., book with miles
Brooklyn – Central (New York), Apr 9–Apr 15, default times

opportunities.name: NPS Find a Park filtered search
opportunities.description: On nps.gov, open Find a Park (See All Parks), pick a filter value in {filter_type} (Activity or Topic), and run the search.
steps: On the nps.gov home page, click 'See All Parks & Search By Map'
Scroll to the Find a Park filters
Open the By Activity or By Topic dropdown
Select the value you want
Click Search

opportunities.name: MTA bridge and tunnel toll lookup by vehicle
opportunities.description: On mta.info, go to Bridges & Tunnels tolls > Toll rates/Tolls by vehicle and open the toll page for {vehicle_type}.
steps: Open mta.info, then go through Menu > Agencies > Bridges & Tunnels, or Fares & Tolls > Bridges and Tunnels tolls
Click Toll Rates or 'Tolls by vehicle'
Select the vehicle type (Cars, Motorcycles, Trucks)
Read the toll rates for the crossing you want
